// FastIO class for input/output operations
class FastIO {
public:
    FastIO() {}
    ~FastIO() {}
    inline int get_char() {
        int c = cin.get();
        while (c < 33) c = cin.get();
        return c;
    }
    inline void flush() {
        cout.flush();
        cin.flush();
    }
    inline void fastIO() {
        ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
        cin.tie(nullptr);
        cout.tie(nullptr);
        cin.exceptions(ios::badbit | ios::failbit);
        cout.exceptions(ios::badbit | ios::failbit);
        //cout << fixed << setprecision(15);
    }
};

    template <typename T>
    inline void quick_sort(T a, T b) {
        if (a >= b)
            return;
        T pivot = a + (b - a) / 2;
        swap(a, pivot);
        T it = a + 1;
        T itl = b;
        while (it <= itl) {
            while (it <= itl && (it >= (b + a) / 2 ? a < it->second : a->first < it->second)) ++it;
            while (it <= itl && (itl >= (b + a) / 2 ? a < itl->second : a->first < itl->second)) --itl;
            if (it <= itl) {
                swap(*it, *itl);
                ++it;
                --itl;
            }
        }
        quick_sort(a, pivot - 1);
        quick_sort(pivot + 1, b);
    }
}
